title: Wild Side
description: A banker who moonlights as a call-girl falls in with a sadistic undercover officer (Steven Bauer), a money launderer (Christopher Walken) and his wife (Joan Chen).

title: Boyka: Undisputed 4
description: Boyka accidentally kills an opponent in the ring, forcing him to question everything he's worked for. When he finds out his opponent's widow is in trouble, he becomes her champion in a series of seemingly impossible fights.

title: The Eagle Has Landed
description: A Nazi colonel (Robert Duvall) drops a colonel (Michael Caine), a task force and an Irishman (Donald Sutherland) into England to kidnap Winston Churchill.

title: A Boy and His Dog
description: A young man and his talking canine set out in search of food, shelter and females in a post-apocalyptic wasteland.

title: The Stunt Man
description: An all-knowing director (Peter O'Toole) toys with a fugitive's (Steve Railsback) mind after making him stuntman on a movie set.

title: Dead Man
description: Circumstances transform a mild-mannered accountant (Johnny Depp) into a notorious Old West gunslinger.

title: Down in the Valley
description: A lawman (David Morse) is suspicious of a charismatic stranger (Edward Norton) who claims to be a former ranch hand and is wooing his teenage daughter (Evan Rachel Wood).

title: The Protector
description: Two NYPD cops are sent to Hong Kong to catch a drug lord who has kidnapped the daughter of his former associate.

title: The Little Shop of Horrors
description: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's carnivorous, forcing him to kill to feed it.

title: Welcome Home, Roxy Carmichael
description: An offbeat Ohio teenager (Winona Ryder) eagerly awaits the return of a legendary wild one she figures is her mother.

title: The Last Seduction
description: An insurance executive (Linda Fiorentino) skips town with drug money and stops at nothing to get what she wants.

title: Compromising Positions
description: The murder of a swinging Long Island dentist puts an ex-reporter housewife (Susan Sarandon) onto a story.

title: The Last Unicorn
description: An inept magician (Alan Arkin) and a ragged scullery woman (Tammy Grimes) join a unicorn's (Mia Farrow) quest to free her kind from an evil king's ocean prison.

title: My Best Fiend
description: Filmmaker Werner Herzog narrates an exploration of his love-hate relationship with actor Klaus Kinski.

title: Trial by Jury
description: A New York mob boss (Armand Assante) tries to ensure his acquittal by scaring a single mother (Joanne Whalley-Kilmer) on the jury.

title: The Warrior's Way
description: Refusing to kill an infant from an enemy clan, a master swordsman (Jang Dong-gun) takes the child and flees to an American frontier town.

title: A Tale of Two Guns
description: In the lawless West, a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves called The Cowboys reigns over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate finally catches up with them.

title: Valentine: The Dark Avenger
description: A chance meeting with a film director leads to a waitress turned actress's transformation into a consummate superhero.

title: Tragedy Girls
description: Teenage crime reporters Sadie and McKayla are hot on the trail of a crazed serial killer. After capturing the maniac and holding him hostage, they soon realize that the best way to boost their social media stardom is to commit the murders themselves.

title: Unlawful Entry
description: A creepy policeman (Ray Liotta) gets close to a Los Angeles couple (Kurt Russell, Madeleine Stowe) in order to drive them apart.

title: Last Straw
description: Masked assailants converge on a roadside diner where a young waitress is working the night shift alone. Trapped inside with no place to go, she soon finds herself in a brutal fight for survival as she tries to make it out alive.

title: My Dinner With Andre
description: A playwright/actor (Wallace Shawn) and a playwright/director (Andre Gregory) have a deep discussion in a restaurant.

title: Whale Rider
description: A Maori girl (Keisha Castle-Hughes) defies her grandfather (Rawiri Paratene) and 1,000 years of tradition to prove she can lead their tribe.

title: Donnie Darko: The Director's Cut
description: An unusual teenager (Jake Gyllenhaal) follows the instructions of the 6-foot-tall rabbit which saved his life.

title: Today You Die
description: A world-class thief (Steven Seagal) escapes from prison to exact revenge on the partners who doubled-crossed him.

title: Two for the Money
description: A former college athlete (Matthew McConaughey) joins forces with a sports consultant (Al Pacino) to handicap football games for high-rolling gamblers.

title: Spotlight
description: Journalists (Mark Ruffalo, Michael Keaton, Rachel McAdams) from The Boston Globe investigate a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

title: Once Upon a Time in China III
description: A martial-arts master (Jet Li) defends his father from several gangs during a competition in Beijing.

title: Tie Me Up! Tie Me Down!
description: A former mental patient (Antonio Banderas) in Spain finds his porno-star dream girl (Victoria Abril) and ties her to her bed.

title: Eraserhead
description: When Henry discovers that a fling with Mary X leaves her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing.

title: Infernal Affairs
description: A troubled officer (Tony Leung) under deep cover and a corrupt cop (Andy Lau) each try to divine the other's identity within a crime lord's organization.

title: Yakuza Wolf 2
description: A man is sent to prison after being betrayed by a yakuza underboss and vows to take revenge. Once released, he attacks in a no-holds barred massacre.

title: To Kill With Intrigue
description: The Honeybee Flower gang kills everyone in Lei mansion but Siao Lei, spared by their leader because she likes him.

title: Once Upon a Time in China
description: A man (Jet Li) must protect his martial-arts school while sorting out his feelings for a young woman (Biao Yuen) who is his aunt by adoption.

title: Masquerade
description: Eleven-year-old Casey is home alone -- until intruders break in to steal her family's priceless artworks. As the stakes grow higher, Casey now finds herself in a fight for her life as the invaders prove they'll stop at nothing to get what they want.

title: Insomnia
description: A yuppie (Cristina Marcos) befriends a real estate agent (Ernesto Alterio) engaged to a woman who shops compulsively.

title: Funny Games
description: Two sadistic collegians torture a vacationing Austrian family (Susanne Lothar, Ulrich Mühe) physically and psychologically.

title: JCVD
description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery.

title: Downfall
description: As the Third Reich crumbles around them, Adolf Hitler's secretary witnesses the final 10 days of the Nazi dictator's life.

title: The Gambler Returns: The Luck of the Draw
description:
S01 E01
An Old West poker player, his pal and an ex-madam meet vintage TV heroes and danger on the way to a big game.

title: Escape to Athena
description: A Greek partisan (Telly Savalas) helps Allied prisoners escape with ancient art from a German major's (Roger Moore) island prison.

title: Journey to the End of the Night
description: A man (Brendan Fraser) hatches a scheme to double-cross his father (Scott Glenn) and steal money from a drug deal.
